title: Catalyst: Growth Sprint Notes & Manager Prep
content:
Quick purpose: scratchpad to organize the next 6-8 weeks of focused work + prep for 1:1 with manager (Mar 12).

Top-level goals (6-8 weeks):
- Increase onboarding NPS for new hires from 72 -> 80 (measured at 30d). Quick experiments: buddy check-ins (wk1), 1:1 onboarding pulse (wk2), trimmed new-hire checklist.
- Launch pilot of manager calibration playbook with Eng Mgrs (5 teams) and collect 10 structured anecdotes.
- Ship two lightweight learning modules for 'coaching at scale' (10-15 min each) and get 40 completions in pilot org.

Current signals / why these matter:
- Recent new-hire survey (Feb cohort) flagged "unclear first week tasks" and "no buddy assigned" — repeated themes in 3/8 responses.
- Manager calibration request from CTO (see JIRA-HR-489) — need a tight, repeatable artifact.

Draft talking points for 1:1 (mar 12):
- Progress update: onboarding experiments rolled out to 3 teams (SRE, Platform, Console); early buddy match rate 60%.
- Request: 0.2 FTE for 6 weeks from Solutions Eng (for pilot coordination) — ask framed as "reduces time-to-productivity by X%".
- Risks: bandwidth during Q2 hiring push; need prioritization signal from you on dedicating Solutions Eng time.
- Career ask: want to own "calibration playbook" end-to-end — stretch opportunity aligns with promotion rubric (coaching and influence).

Anecdote bank (short vignettes to use in calibration):
- "Aisha — removed blockers for new PMs by creating a 7-item launch checklist; ramp time shortened by ~10 days" (data: onboarding survey + first-week task completion rates).
- "SRE hire — buddy mismatch; led to 2 missed syncs and delayed access requests; resolved by manual buddy rematch on day 3".

Quick metrics to surface:
- New hire survey response rate: 37% (n=30).
- Buddy match rate (auto-assigned): 60% -> target 90%.
- First-week checklist completion: median 4/7 tasks completed.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Can we get API access to HRIS so buddy assignments can be automated? (ask infra/eng)
- Who owns the training completion metric? Ops or Learning?
- Draft of calibration playbook due Mar 24 — need review from Noah and Aisha by Mar 17.

Micro-actions (this week):
- 3/10: Send pilot invite to 5 Eng managers (template + calendar block).
- 3/11: Walkthrough of module 1 with Aisha; gather feedback.
- 3/12: 1:1 with manager — ask for decision on Solutions Eng allocation.

Notes to self (style / framing cues for manager):
- Use outcome language: "reduced ramp time" > "ran onboarding sessions".
- Be specific about tradeoffs: "0.2 FTE for 6 weeks buys X".
- Bring one concrete win + one open ask.

Scratch ideas (brainstorm):
- Small-signal experiment: automated Slack DM on day 2 asking "Did your buddy meet you?" -> capture yes/no and one line.
- Calibration short-format: 2-slide template + 5-line anecdote prompts so managers can submit quickly.

Reference links / artifacts to attach before 1:1:
- draft onboarding checklist (Google Doc)
- preliminary module slides (draft)
- JIRA-HR-489 (calibration request)

Random notes / half-formed phrasing:
- "If we can create a low-effort manager input form, we unlock more reliable calibration evidence." — test by sending to 10 managers only.
- "Pilot should feel like less work not more; templates + async capture is key."

End-of-doc quick action list:
- [ ] Finalize calendar invite for pilot managers (send 3/10)
- [ ] Ask manager for Solutions Eng allocation in 1:1 (3/12)
- [ ] Share draft calibration playbook for review (due 3/17)

Last check: keep this doc messy — it's allowed. Pull from it when writing more polished artifacts.
